text: A floating static route is configured with an administrative distance of 200. When is it used?
choices: Only when the primary route with a better (lower) AD is withdrawn from the table
explanation: Its worse AD keeps it out of the table while the primary is present. The caveat that matters: it only helps if the primary actually withdraws — if the interface stays up because the failure is beyond the first hop, the backup never activates, which is what IP SLA tracking is for.
